tool_calls.name:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os, tempfile
path = Path('pipeline/workflow.go')
text = path.read_text()
renames = {
    'LoadInput': 'ReadRequest',
    'CheckInput': 'ValidateRequest',
    'NormalizeValue': 'CanonicalizeValue',
    'MapFields': 'ProjectFields',
    'RouteValue': 'DispatchValue',
    'StampEvent': 'AnnotateEvent',
    'CountItems': 'TallyItems',
    'MergeParts': 'CombineParts',
}
for old, new in renames.items():
    text = text.replace(old, new)
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, prefix='.workflow.go.')
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as f:
        f.write(text)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp, path)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(tmp):
        os.unlink(tmp)
PY
go test ./..."
